description.description: A large gray naval frigate at sea, featuring a prominent '76' on the bow. The ship has various radar equipment, antennas, a primary gun turret on the foredeck, and a red stripe along the waterline.

A side-profile view of an Iranian Jamaran-class frigate sailing on the open sea. The ship is painted light gray with a red hull below the waterline. The pennant number '76' is visible on the bow. A blue and white helicopter is parked on the flight deck at the aft of the vessel. A watermark for 'MEHR' news agency is visible in the bottom left corner.
